title: Timeouts and 5xx on orders-api
description: PagerDuty alert: orders-api p95 latency reached 1.8s (normally ~141ms) and error rate peaked at 18.9%.
root_cause_detail: inventory-service responded slowly (CPU throttling on its node pool), so orders-api calls timed out at 2000ms. The degradation was intermittent (flapping).
expected_symptoms: orders-api downstream_latency_ms rises from ~90ms to ~2.1s (client timeout 2000ms)
timeout and retry logs on calls from orders-api to inventory-service
orders-api p95 latency rises to ~1.8s, error rate up to ~18.9%
orders-api CPU and memory stay near baseline
inventory-service server-side latency elevated while its CPU and memory stay normal
orders-api db_connection_utilization moderately elevated (~73%) but not saturated
resolution: Moved inventory-service pods off the degraded node pool and tuned the orders-api circuit breaker.
